blurb: The Port Hotel and Marina is a 7-acre resort located on Florida's Gulf of Mexico in Crystal River, Florida. Guests can stay in waterfront rooms with views of Kings Bay and enjoy amenities including a dive center, boat and kayak rentals, and manatee tours. The hotel has a restaurant and tiki bar on premises and offers guided manatee tours by boat or snorkeling with manatees.
